mentions.name: Old-style RTS game
mentions.description: An old-style RTS game the author is vibing into existence, experimenting with how far local AI models can go for drawing, 3D models, rigging and sprites, while using Claude to generate code.
mentions.problem: Gluing AI-generated code and graphics together still requires plenty of manual work, even though Claude handles a lot of the coding.
mentions.author: snicky
